# n7 - Screens, templates, and docs

The roadmap plan screen prints the tree, the roadmap template teaches `## Graph` so a new roadmap
is never born graphless, and the roadmap skill documents the three verbs. Every change is
additive: a roadmap with no graph renders exactly the bytes it renders today. The whole-cycle-path
reporting from `roadmap-next` belongs to n9, which owns `roadmap_queue.rb`.
